structured_output.notes: Implemented standard-compliant favorite/star bookmark UI following the MiniLinks product specification. The star toggle buttons dispatch PATCH requests with native boolean JSON payloads, update DOM state and in-memory caches, and automatically remove unfavorited cards when the favorites filter is active. Filter states combine seamlessly with query searches.
structured_output.summary: Implemented favorite/star bookmark UI in index.html, style.css, and app.js, including the Favorites filter button in search/filter controls, star toggle buttons (★/☆) per bookmark card triggering PATCH /api/bookmarks/<id> with is_favorite updates, filtering by favorites, and dedicated star styling.
